protocol.batchnorm: update during shared initial training; freeze running statistics during all five AL rounds in every method
protocol.targets: once per independent seed, after shared 40-epoch initial training, on fixed center-cropped 16x8 training anchors; shared by all methods; never tuned with official validation

acquisition.covariance: fresh diagonal class covariance from currently labeled training images; shrinkage 1e-5
acquisition.badge: exact factorized last-linear-weight gradient kernel; no random projection; bias excluded
acquisition.noise_stability: independent full-parameter Gaussian output-deviation implementation; five draws; exact concatenation/no projection; greedy k-center; not authors repository reproduction

statistics.test: paired t and exact sign flip; Holm over these two supplementary clean-accuracy contrasts only; original seven-contrast family unchanged

comparisons.test: paired t and exact sign flip; Holm over these two supplementary clean-accuracy contrasts only; original seven-contrast family unchanged

plan.robustness: same full-set standard 8/255 endpoint, supplementary descriptive result
remaining_outside_this_script: tuned fixed/schedule and alignment-isolation controls if stronger mechanism claims are retained
fresh-seed or second-setting confirmation if broader claims are retained
full-label reference only for a label-saving claim
public deposit, declarations, and final manuscript audit
plan.accuracy_units: fraction; multiply differences and intervals by 100 for percentage points
plan.intervals: individual 95 percent paired-t intervals, not simultaneous intervals
plan.exact_test_resolution: minimum two-sided p=0.03125; two-contrast Holm cannot reject at 0.05 with six pairs
